notes: 10-task difficulty-stratified subset (--split parity), 3 runs per side, Harbor 0.25.0 on Modal. Both sides route Claude Code through the upstream rb-claude-code-proxy to alibaba/qwen3.7-plus on an OpenAI-compatible gateway (no dated model ID is published for it) and use the same judge (alibaba/qwen3.7-plus, temperature 0). Run value = mean task score over the 10 tasks, in percent; task score = mean of Prog and VLM; build failures and empty submissions score 0 as upstream scores them. One Harbor trial (astrovia.example, run 2) ended on a model API timeout, which the upstream scorer marks as api_error rather than a model score; it was rerun once and the rerun is the value used. Both sides apply patch_scorer.py (upstream issue QwenLM/RecreationWorld#6). Scores sit near the floor for this model (the paper reports 10.15% on the full Web split) and single tasks flip between 0 and a small score from run to run on both sides.

metrics.metric: Task score (mean of Prog and VLM), %
